Choices

Copy in one go Recommended

Two days of read-only, as the plan says: export --all.

  • Pro: Simple
  • Con: Longer freeze
Copy by space

Each space is copied apart:

  • Docs first
  • Then the rest, as the plan says: export --space
  • Pro: Short freezes
  • Con: Links break between spaces
  • Con: Twice the work

decided2030-03-28

The wiki moves to the new host

The old server is out of support in May.

Old May

The new host is supported for five years.

  • Pass
    Do names in Japanese go through?

    Saved as UTF-8, and found by a search.

    How: curl, adding and searching

  • Fail
    Does it run in an old browser?

    Safari 15 has no :has(), and the rows of the list break:

    • from Safari 16 they are right
    • a fifth of the machines are on 15

    How: By hand in each browser

  • Pass
    Can the old data be read?

    The export of 2023 reads, its dates converted.

  • Fail
    Does a wrong password stop after five?

    After four; >= is written for >.

  • Pass
    Does the search answer in a second?

    420 ms on average.

  • Not checked
    Does it go through the proxy?

    Not from here; the network team was asked.
